主要内容: On September 28, 2012, OYO Geospace Corporation announced a name change to Geospace Technologies Corporation and a ticker symbol change to GEOS, effective October 1, 2012. The name change followed the sale of OYO Corporation U.S.A.'s stake in February 2012, resulting in no further affiliation with OYO Corporation. The company designs and manufactures instruments and equipment for the oil and gas industry, including seismic data acquisition and reservoir characterization tools, as well as other industrial products like thermal printing equipment and film. Securities explicitly mentioned in the source include OYO Geospace (OYOG).
